fullDesc: Nintendo released Super Mario Bros. in 1985 for the Nintendo Entertainment System, designed by Shigeru Miyamoto and Takashi Tezuka. Its smooth controls and level design set the standard for platform games.
realFacts: It sold more than 40 million copies
The NES helped rebuild the industry after the 1983 crash
Koji Kondo wrote its famous theme music
Mario became one of the best-known characters in the world
